name: architecture-viz-studio
description: Use when the user wants to visualize, present, "show", animate, or build an interactive web page for a software architecture, system design, technical concept, data model, pipeline, or product story — phrases like "intro page", "architecture visualization", "interactive diagram", "scrollytelling", "3D system map", "ERD page", "design walkthrough", "make our architecture look impressive", or "present this design to stakeholders". Also use before hand-rolling Three.js, GSAP or SVG architecture diagrams from scratch, or when the user wants visual feedback on such a page through an edit mode.

findings.excerpt: (Scripts need Playwright: `npm i -D @playwright/test axe-core && npx playwright install chromium`.)
its `node_modules`. Install once: `npm i -D @playwright/test axe-core pngjs && npx playwright install chromium`.
